content.text: 1. When you equip a pair of wings (Equip Effect)
2. When you own the wings (Owned Effect)

Wings can be upgraded or “Enhanced” up to a maximum of level 10 where the “Owned Effect” will increase. At level 0, wings will not show all their stats. When enhancing a pair of wings to +1, an additional stat will become available…in the case of the Brawler Wings (Abyss Shop Wings), the tooltip will only show the “Owned Effects” at base level 0. Upon upgrading these wings, you get Weapon Damage Boost making these wings high value.

The source says the base tooltip only shows Owned Effects, but figure 083 visibly includes Equip and Owned sections. Its fourth owned Weapon Damage Boost line is absent at base and present after enhancement; the hidden-line explanation remains supported.
When upgrading, only the top stat line and the last “hidden” stat line get upgraded.
The 2nd and 3rd stat under the “Owned Effect” do
get upgraded when leveling up. I’ve indented those lines.

Awaken Pride Wings just released and will overtake the Talisra
Why is everyone running Eroded (Front Attack Damage Boost wings)?

Frontal/Back Attack Damage Boost is a newer stat that was introduced and it is in its own multiplicative damage bucket. Due to the nature of Front/Back Damage Boost being a very high value damage stat, ranged classes have begun to incorporate it into their builds despite having less access to the stat compared to melee positional classes
What about Sorcerer and Spiritmaster, it doesn’t seem like they are running it?
: Simply put, these two classes have abilities in their kit that do not take advantage of Front/Back Attack Boost.
